summary: Structural Backend protocol — the single typed contract every backend must satisfy. Runtime-checkable via isinstance. Defines connect(), close(), context-manager dunder methods, and the full inspection API (list_tables, list_namespaces, inspect_table, inspect_namespace, inspect_catalog).
extension_points: Backend protocol — implement this structural interface to add a new backend type
lifecycle_notes: Uses @runtime_checkable so isinstance(obj, Backend) works for type guards.
documentation_hooks: Protocol reference is the anchor for 'how to add a new backend' contributor guide
inspect_* method signatures define the uniform inspection API across ibis and iceberg
risks: Protocol structural matching can silently accept types that satisfy the interface but behave differently — runtime_checkable only checks method presence, not signatures.

evidence.detail: Exported from package root as public API
